title: Odile and the Drop
author: Beatrix Thornbury
blurb: Theo Villalobos, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
